anchorLab.header.title: Ilabhu ye-ankora yomlingiswa
anchorLab.header.lead: Yakha isethi ye-ankora yomlingiswa we-3D othwetshulwe ngaphambili, ezinhlangothini nangemuva, bese uhlola kule divayisi ukuthi abazokhethwa abadwetshwe yi-AI bafana kangakanani nayo.
anchorLab.limits.title: Ngicela ufunde kuqala
anchorLab.limits.score: Amaphuzu ayisithenjwa se-heuristic esiqhathanisa ngokukhululeka ukusatshalaliswa kombala, iphalethi, izilinganiso zesilhouette ne-hash yesakhiwo. Akanqumi ukuthi izithombe ezimbili zibonisa umlingiswa ofanayo yini.
anchorLab.limits.noGuarantee: Ukusebenzisa ama-ankora akuqinisekisi umlingiswa ofanayo kukho konke ukusikwa. Isimo esihlukile, ukukhanya noma ukufreyima kunganciphisa amaphuzu ngisho nakumlingiswa ofanayo.
anchorLab.limits.local: Izithombe azilokothi zithunyelwe kuseva futhi zicutshungulwa kule divayisi kuphela. Akukho ukuqashelwa kobuso noma ukukhishwa kwebhayomethrikhi okusetshenziswayo.
anchorLab.limits.virtualOnly: Sebenzisa izithombe zabalingiswa abangokoqobo onabo noma onemvume yokuzisebenzisa kuphela. Ungalayishi izithombe zabantu bangempela.
anchorLab.limits.stage: Ukuthwebula ngqo kusuka esiteji se-3D akuzange kuxhunywe okwamanje. Okwamanje, beka izithombe ezilondolozwe kusuka ku-3D ku-engeli ngayinye ukuze wakhe isethi.
anchorLab.identity.title: 1. Igama le-ankora nomlingiswa womthombo
anchorLab.identity.anchorId.label: I-id ye-ankora
anchorLab.identity.anchorId.hint: Izinhlamvu ezincane, amadijithi namahayifeni, kufika ezinhlamvini eziyi-40. Kusetshenziswa emagameni efayela. Isibonelo: hero-01
anchorLab.identity.anchorId.error: Sebenzisa izinhlamvu ezincane, amadijithi namahayifeni kuphela, futhi ungaqali noma ungaqedi nge-hayifeni. Kufake futhi njenge-hero-01.
anchorLab.identity.characterId.label: I-id yomlingiswa womthombo
anchorLab.identity.characterId.hint: I-id yomlingiswa le nkora ethathwe kuyo. Izinhlamvu, amadijithi kanye no-. _ : - kufika ezinhlamvini eziyi-64. Isibonelo: char-7
anchorLab.identity.characterId.error: Qala ngohlamvu noma idijithi bese usebenzisa izinhlamvu, amadijithi kanye no-. _ : - kuphela kufika ezinhlamvini eziyi-64. Kufake futhi njenge-char-7.
anchorLab.rights.title: 2. Ukuqinisekiswa kwamalungelo
anchorLab.rights.confirm: Lezi zithombe zibonisa umlingiswa ongokoqobo engingowami noma enginemvume yokumsebenzisa, futhi akuzona izithombe noma ukufana kwabantu bangempela.
anchorLab.rights.confirmHint: Maka lokhu ukuze wengeze izithombe bese ulanda isethi. Isitatimende sigcinwa futhi kumafayela alandiwe.
anchorLab.rights.note.label: Inothi lomthombo nemvume (ongakukhetha)
anchorLab.rights.note.hint: Kufika ezinhlamvini eziyi-300. Kugcinwa kwirekhodi lamalungelo lamafayela alandiwe.
anchorLab.rights.locked: Hlola ukuqinisekiswa kwamalungelo kuqala. Izithombe azikwazi ukwengezwa kuze kuqinisekiswe.
anchorLab.set.title: 3. Isethi ye-ankora
anchorLab.set.lead: Beka isithombe esisodwa ku-engeli ngayinye kweziyisithupha: ngaphambili, kwesokunxele 3/4, kwesokunxele, ngemuva, kwesokudla nakwesokudla 3/4. Kwesokunxele nakwesokudla kulandela umzimba womlingiswa. Uma esinye sesibhangqa sokunxele/sokudla singekho, kubhekiselwa ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela.
anchorLab.set.dropAll.hint: Uma igama lefayela liqukethe igama le-engeli elifana nengaphambili, kwesokunxele, kwesokudla, ngemuva noma 3-4, i-engeli iyaqagelwa bese ibekwa kuwe. Ngicela uhlole kabili ama-engeli aqagelwe.
anchorLab.set.guessed: Kuqagelwe i-engeli yamafayela ayi-{count} kusuka emagameni awo. Ngicela uhlole ukuthi alungile yini.
anchorLab.set.unassigned: Amafayela ayi-{count} ane-engeli engaziwa awangezwanga. Wabeke esikhaleni ngokwakho.
anchorLab.set.accept: PNG, JPG noma WebP, kufika ku-{max} MB ngayinye
anchorLab.set.recommend: Kunconywa: isithombe esime mpo esingu-2:3, {width}×{height}px, ingemuva eliyisicaba, isimo esingathathi hlangothi
anchorLab.set.hashNote: I-hash ibalwa kuphela kusuka ku-id ye-ankora, i-id yomlingiswa womthombo, ama-engeli nokuqukethwe kwesithombe. Asikho isitembu sesikhathi esifakiwe, ngakho izithombe ezifanayo zinikeza i-hash efanayo.
anchorLab.set.tooLarge: Isethi ingu-{size} MB, ngaphezu komkhawulo ongu-{max} MB. Shintsha ezinye izithombe ngamafayela amancane bese uzama futhi.
anchorLab.set.invalid: Isethi ayikwazi ukudalwa. Hlola i-id ye-ankora nezithombe, bese uzama futhi.

anchorLab.export.title: 4. Ukulanda nephakethe lesithenjwa
anchorLab.export.lead: Landa isethi njenge-ZIP enezithombe, ulwazi lwesethi, irekhodi lamalungelo kanye nedokhumenti yephakethe lesithenjwa somqambi we-AI.
anchorLab.export.done: I-ZIP idaliwe futhi yalandwa. Iqukethe amafayela ayi-{count}.
anchorLab.export.cancelled: Ukwakha i-ZIP kukhanseliwe. Zama futhi uma ukudinga.
anchorLab.export.error: I-ZIP ayikwazanga ukudalwa. Hlola izithombe bese uzama futhi.
anchorLab.export.needIdentity: Faka i-id ye-ankora evumelekile ne-id yomlingiswa womthombo ukuze ulande.
anchorLab.export.needImages: Engeza okungenani isithombe esisodwa ukuze ulande.
anchorLab.export.contents: I-ZIP iqukethe i-images/, i-anchor-set.json, i-rights.json, i-reference-pack.json ne-README.txt.
anchorLab.pack.title: Ukubuka kuqala kwephakethe lesithenjwa somqambi we-AI
anchorLab.pack.lead: Lokhu kungeza ama-ankora njengezithenjwa zabalingiswa kanye nesimo sokudubula/ukwakheka njengezithenjwa zendlela kuphakethe lesithenjwa lesithombe elikhona (v1). Akukho ukungenisa ngqo kumqambi okwamanje, ngakho sebenzisa i-reference-pack.json elandiwe.
anchorLab.pack.empty: Ukubuka kuqala kwephakethe lesithenjwa kuvela uma i-id ye-ankora, ukuqinisekiswa kwamalungelo nezithombe sezilungile.

anchorLab.candidates.title: 5. Qhathanisa izithombe zabazokhethwa
anchorLab.candidates.lead: Qhathanisa abazokhethwa abadwetshwe yi-AI nama-ankora ukuze ubone amaphuzu esithenjwa se-heuristic nokuthi yini ehlukile. Amaphuzu ayisithenjwa kuphela futhi akanqumi ukuthi ngabe umlingiswa ofanayo yini.

anchorLab.score.disclaimer: La maphuzu aqhathanisa ngokukhululeka ukusatshalaliswa kombala, iphalethi yombala evelele iyonke, izilinganiso zesilhouette ne-hash yesakhiwo. Akanqumi ukuthi ngabe umlingiswa ofanayo yini: isimo esihlukile, ukukhanya noma ukufreyima kungawanciphisa kumlingiswa ofanayo, futhi umdwebo onemibala efanayo kodwa ohlukile ungathola amaphuzu aphezulu.

anchorLab.feature.title: Ukufana ngesici
anchorLab.feature.note: Iphalethi iqhathanisa imibala evelele yesithombe sonke kuphela, ngaphandle kokucabanga izingxenye ezifana nezinwele, isikhumba noma izingubo. Izisindo zikhethwe ngabantu.

anchorLab.compare.empty: Khetha ozokhethwa ukuze umbuke eduze kwe-ankora.
